AOV for FR android 1P electronics search spiked +122% from 190.77 EUR (baseline) to 424.36 EUR (incident), a +233.6 EUR absolute increase. The platform discounts during the incident hour would reduce net order value if AOV is calculated post-discount, or not affect GMV-based AOV if calculated pre-discount. In neither case do discounts explain an AOV increase; they would exert downward pressure on net AOV or be neutral on gross AOV.

The coupon-day-electronics campaign (10% of reference-price GMV as platform discounts) was active during the incident hour with ~1,296 EUR in platform discounts, but this campaign cannot explain the +122% AOV spike because platform discounts reduce customer-paid amounts (lowering net AOV) or are excluded from GMV (not affecting gross AOV). The AOV increase points to a mix shift toward higher-priced electronics or larger basket sizes during that hour.
